themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Articles focusing on AI agents that can perform research tasks autonomously, taking initiative and executing complex workflows.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Tools and platforms that leverage AI to assist researchers in various aspects of their work, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Applications of AI that condense large amounts of text, research papers, or meeting transcripts into concise summaries.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: AI tools designed to help developers write, debug, and optimize code, often integrating with IDEs or code editors.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Research and discussions on how AI is affecting jobs, employment, skill requirements, and the overall labor market.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Studies and analyses of user interactions with AI chatbots, including their impact on mental health, decision-making, and companionship.

themes.name: AI for design & research
themes.description: AI applications specifically for enhancing the design process and user research activities, including ideation and prototyping.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: The use of AI to automate, enhance, or analyze usability testing processes for products and services.

themes.name: AI customer insights
themes.description: Leveraging AI to analyze customer data and feedback to derive actionable insights for business and product development.

themes.name: AI sentiment & feedback analysis
themes.description: Using AI to automatically process and understand the sentiment and opinions expressed in text or voice data.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
